_what: The 2–4 authored SVG plates (design doc §4.2 row 22), plus the section heading (row 6/§2 VISUALS). Each plate's <title> and <desc> live INSIDE its svg file and are mirrored into the JSON-LD by {%extract%}, so the drawing's own words are the single source. png = the rendered raster the JSON-LD and og:image point at (plate index 1 is the og:image, the anatomy plate). caption_html is the frozen caption under the plate (the visuals owner slots it). plate_class and post are layout-fidelity fields (never copy): plate_class puts the extra 'plate-1' class on the first plate only (omit on the others); post is the exact whitespace after a plate's closing tag — every plate but the last defaults to the normal inter-plate indent, so only the LAST plate in the array needs an explicit post (it closes the wrapping .plates div instead, at a shallower indent). New page: keep plate 0's plate_class and the LAST plate's post; everything else uses the defaults.
